Added More structure to API for Custom ancients just looking for properties in the Custom Ancient

Include BaseLib force-spawn ancients even when IsValidForAct returns false. BaseLib intentionally separates normal pool eligibility from ShouldForceSpawn, so filtering only by act validity could hide Act 1 ancients such as Phoenix. Check ancient validity starting from Act 1 when calculating reward offsets. The previous search began at Act 2, causing valid Act 1 ancients to report an unknown minimum act and fall back unnecessarily. Read RitsuLib act validity through IModAncientActValidity. This also supports ancients that implement the interface explicitly instead of exposing a public IsValidForAct method.
